title: Bounded context-pack builder (AD-044..AD-046; 0A.4 budgets)
objective: Build tools/context_pack.py producing the smallest complete packet for a task/role/provider under explicit byte and estimated-token bounds: Section 12 inputs and default exclusions, context.md + context.meta.json + evidence/ output with per-source digests, omission and truncation records, sufficiency flag, and overflow behavior that splits or summarizes deterministically but never silently truncates material sources (AD-046).
business_reason: 0A.8 item 5 (bounded context packets) is a blocking minimum-autonomy capability; AD-044..AD-046 and the 0A.4 ceilings are explicit directive requirements.
forbidden_paths: any dependency manifest or lockfile (stdlib only)
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (executable): context_pack.py --task --role --provider --max-bytes --out produces context.md + context.meta.json + evidence/ with every included file digested, omitted categories listed, bounds and truncation status recorded, and a role-sufficiency flag (all Section 12.3 fields; schema test).

AS-2 (executable): default exclusions honored - whole PRD, directive registry, historical reports, transcripts, unrelated packets, generated artifacts, city datasets, whole code graph (fixture test; Section 12.2).
AS-3 (executable): overflow triggers deterministic split/summarize with exact artifact references; a material source is never silently truncated (AD-046 test).
AS-4 (executable): a reviewer-role packet includes primary-source hunks sufficient to verify a worker claim, not merely the worker's summary (fixture assertion; Section 12.3).
risks: Token estimation is heuristic - record bytes AND estimated tokens; ceilings are engineering policy, not billing claims.
